facts.subject: Valhalla rice exports
facts.statement: Valhalla is the second rice exporter in the region and also a miner.

source_ref.text_snippet: Valhalla is the second rice exporter in the region and also a miner.

facts.subject: Valhalla main exports
facts.statement: The main exports are rice, copper ore and a small amount of specialty metals.

source_ref.text_snippet: The main exports are rice, copper ore and a small amount of specialty metals.

facts.subject: Valhalla imports
facts.statement: The country imports machinery, much of it for mining and food processing.

source_ref.text_snippet: The country imports machinery, much of it for mining and food processing.

facts.subject: Valhalla export routes
facts.statement: Rice and metal shipments leave through several commercial terminals rather than a single named hub.

source_ref.text_snippet: Rice and metal shipments leave through several commercial terminals rather than a single named hub.

facts.subject: Granite Mining
facts.statement: Granite Mining, a copper miner, is the best-known firm.

source_ref.text_snippet: Granite Mining, a copper miner, is the best-known firm.

facts.subject: Valhalla mining sector
facts.statement: The mining sector supports engineering, haulage and repair businesses, while the rice trade is handled by a large number of independent growers and cooperatives.

source_ref.text_snippet: The mining sector supports engineering, haulage and repair businesses, while the rice trade is handled by a large number of independent growers and cooperatives.

facts.subject: Valhalla mining towns
facts.statement: Mining towns in the hills are linked by haul roads to the coast, and processing plants sit near the pits.

source_ref.text_snippet: Mining towns in the hills are linked by haul roads to the coast, and processing plants sit near the pits.

facts.subject: Valhalla rice farms
facts.statement: Rice farms in the lowlands use a separate network of smaller roads and stores.

source_ref.text_snippet: Rice farms in the lowlands use a separate network of smaller roads and stores.
